newsitem.title: USA: Pharmacia & Upjohn launch growth test kit.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia & Upjohn launch growth test kit.

text.p: Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc said Monday it has launched a kit for doctors to help children who undergo tests to determine if they lack a hormone that stimulates growth.
The kit, called the Stimulation Test Physician Kit, is designed for physicians to give to pediatric patients and families who face tests to determine growth hormone deficiency, the company said.
It is designed to help doctors educate parents about growth-related conditions and make children more comfortable taking the test, Pharmacia & Upjohn said.
